00047 /**
00048  * @brief HxDateTimeFormat
00049  *
00050  * This enumeration allows the user to specify the modifiers that they would
00051  * like to apply to the formatting string for the locale.
00052  */ 
00053 typedef enum HxDateTimeFormat_t {
00054     HX_DT_UNMODIFIED = 0
00055     , HX_DT_HIDE_SECONDS = 0x01
00056     , HX_DT_2_DIGIT_YEAR = 0x02
00057     , HX_DT_4_DIGIT_YEAR = 0x04
00058     , HX_DT_ALL_NUMERIC  = 0x08
00059     , HX_DT_LONG_DAYS    = 0x10     /**< Friday, not Fri */
00060     , HX_DT_LONG_MONTHS  = 0x20     /**< March, not Mar */
00061     , HX_DT_LOWER_AMPM   = 0x40     /**< lower-case am/pm, if present */
00062     , HX_DT_NOTZ         = 0x80     /**< remove timezone string, e.g. PDT */
00063     , HX_DT_HOURS_NO_PAD = 0x100    /**< do not pad hour with leading 0 */
00064     , HX_DT_HIDE_YEAR    = 0x200    /**< do not show year */
00065     , HX_DT_SHORT_DAYS   = 0x400   /**< Friday, not Fri */
00066     , HX_DT_HIDE_MONTH   = 0x800    /**< do not show month */
00067     , HX_DT_NO_AMPM      = 0x1000   /**< remove am/pm, if present */
00068 #ifdef ERICS_ABANDONED_CHANGES
00069     , HX_DT_SPACEONLY    = 0x2000   /**< space the only separator allowed */
00070 #endif
00071 } HxDateTimeFormat;

00074 /**

00078  * string should be the formatting string from the locale file modified by the
00079  * available HxDateTimeFormat_t modifiers.
00080  *
00081  * @param item           IN:    the nl item to be used valid value include:
00082  *                                  D_T_FMT
00083  *                                  D_FMT
00084  *                                  T_FMT
00085  * @param modifier       IN:    The modification flags to be used.  These can
00086  *                              be used in combination like a bitmask.  If you
00087  *                              do not use SHOW_SECONDS or HIDE_SECONDS that
00088  *                              implies that the specification in the locale
00089  *                              file will be honored.  The same applies to year.
00090  * @param pLocaleString OUT:    Returns a string which is preallocated and only
00091  *                              valid until a subsequent call to this function.

00096  *                              *pStringLength is set to the required size, and
